text: The algebraic derivation chain from (0/1) to playable tone: Anuttara (0/1) → raw # = SPANDA_SEED_BITS (0x03), both poles fused, non-dual seed. Inversion-act (#) → Paramaśiva bimba/pratibimba → ANANDA_BIMBA, ANANDA_PRATIBIMBA, .rodata 12×12 nibble-packed matrices. M0 base + M1 offset (+1) → The four foundational ratios: 4/3, 3/2, 9/8, 16/9, encoded as matrix-cell readings (i:j). Pure-ratio interpretation → The 12-note chromatic palette: WT-0 ∪ WT-1 = full mod12 chromatic, the two whole-tone helices conjugated. Epogdoon-stacking within each helix → Mode + Key selection: 12 MEF lenses × 7 context-frames. The entire chain is grounded in the matheme's own structure; every step is a named unfolding of the same non-dual binary.

M1-0' Canonical Source is the read-only API layer serving immutable harmonic data to the walker. It carries the .rodata matrix archetypes: ANANDA_BIMBA (12×12 bimba matrix), ANANDA_PRATIBIMBA (12×12 pratibimba reflection), ANANDA_SUM (bimba + pratibimba sum matrix), ANANDA_QUINTESSENCE (the 0/1 rule-and-tuple family). The Cl(4,2) basis at CL42_BASIS[6] carries the six canonical generators. The Hopf LUTs map quaternion pairs to S³ fibre coordinates. RING_QUATERNION_LUT[12] carries explicit quaternion values per ring position. Two DR rings track digit-root phase: DR_RING_MAHAMAYA = {1,2,4,8,7,5} (doubling family) and DR_RING_PARASHAKTI = {3,6,9,3,6,9} (tripling family). The invariant is Spanda↔Ananda parallel-track: six _Static_assert guards in m1.h verify the six strata remain mutually consistent.

M1-2' Harmonic Engine reads dual-register vortex cells from the kernel profile and exposes them as walk-step intervals. The six canonical Ananda matrix families from the Vortex Modulae CSV each carry a raw/no-digit-root affine face and a digit-root recursive face: #X+0, #X+1, sum, two diffs, and the 0/1 rule/quintessence family. The current C .rodata stores the digit-root face for ANANDA_BIMBA, ANANDA_PRATIBIMBA, ANANDA_SUM, and ANANDA_QUINTESSENCE; the raw 12×12 face must be carried through the C generator/API before Tranche 10.10 closure. The profile-bus contract is AnandaVortexProjection per Tranche 10.10, carrying active_cell_value for both raw and DR cells.

M1-5' Topology Analyzer renders the played visual torus — quaternionic TDA finding the shape of the active walk. The rendering primitive is quat_slerp (quaternion spherical linear interpolation) between consecutive profile ticks on the S³ fibre of the Hopf bundle, projected to S² as the visualisation surface. The quaternion ring values from RING_QUATERNION_LUT[12] provide the S³ anchor points. The 720° double-cover means the visual torus completes a full identity-return only after two traversals (720°, not 360°). TORUS_GENUS = 1 and DOUBLE_COVER_DEG = 720 are the kernel-anchored constants. The Hopf bundle S³ → S² → S¹ provides the geometric interpretation: the S¹ base is the chromatic fifths circle, the S² total space is the visualisation surface.

The K² torus is parameterised with major radius R = 16/9 (the QL totality-ratio) and minor radius r = 1 (the standing-identity unit). The torus surface is therefore proportioned by the same ratio that governs the matheme's harmonic mathematics. The 84-state lattice cells are embedded as surface patches on the torus: each (lens, mode) cell occupies a rectangular patch parameterised by the lens angular position (major circle) and the mode angular position (minor circle). The audio_octet[8] values from the profile attach as local oscillator frequencies rendered at the cell's surface coordinates. The 8+4 partition (eight explicate-sung positions + four implicate-nodal positions) maps to the torus as eight visible particle-emitters and four satellite nodal glyphs.
